Ersetzen or Ergänzen? German B1 Change Word Choice

Choose ersetzen for replacement and ergänzen for adding missing material. Practise German text and object contexts with translations and explained answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Ersetzen means replacing something with something else: ein Wort durch ein anderes ersetzen. Ergänzen means adding what is missing or completing something: einen Text um ein Beispiel ergänzen. Replacement removes or substitutes the specified element; supplementation keeps it and adds material.

Common mistake to avoid

Ergänzen does not normally mean deleting the original element and putting a different one in its place. Use ersetzen for that replacement operation.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich ersetze das beschädigte Kabel durch ein neues.I replace the damaged cable with a new one.
Worked example 2Ich ergänze den Bericht um eine kurze Zusammenfassung.I add a short summary to the report.
Worked example 3Wir ersetzen das falsche Datum im Entwurf.We replace the incorrect date in the draft.
Worked example 4Wir ergänzen die Liste um zwei fehlende Namen.We add two missing names to the list.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose ersetzen for the stated substitution and ergänzen for the stated addition. Use the infinitive. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Das alte Bauteil soll einem neuen weichen; wir müssen es ___. (replace)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: ersetzen

Ersetzen substitutes the new component for the old one.

Question 2. Der Absatz bleibt; wir möchten ihn um ein Beispiel ___. (supplement)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: ergänzen

Ergänzen adds the example while retaining the paragraph.

Question 3. Das falsche Wort sollen wir durch das richtige ___. (replace)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: ersetzen

Etwas durch etwas ersetzen is the replacement pattern.

Question 4. Die fehlende Quellenangabe möchten wir ___. (add what is missing)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: ergänzen

Ergänzen supplies the missing reference.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
